Bhutan PM Invites Bangladesh Counterpart to Visit

Bhutan's Prime Minister has extended an invitation to Bangladesh's Prime Minister, Tarique Rahman, to visit Bhutan. The invitation was extended, though specific details regarding the timing or purpose of the potential visit were not provided in the coverage. Separately, it was reported that Prime Minister Tarique Rahman is likely to visit Delhi in November, following previous roadblocks.
